00129 Text Text::toUpper() const throw()
00130 {
00131     const char *thisArray = this->getArray();
00132     const int size = this->size();
00133     
00134     if(thisArray == 0 || size <= 0) return *this;
00135     
00136     Text newText = Text::withSize(size, false);
00137     char *newArray = newText.getArray();        
00138     
00139     for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00140     {
00141         char c = thisArray[i];
00142         
00143         if(c >= 'a' && c <= 'z')
00144             c -= 32;
00145         
00146         newArray[i] = c;
00147     }           
00148     
00149     return newText;
00150 }

00153 {
00154     const char *thisArray = this->getArray();
00155     const int size = this->size();

00158

00195 Text Text::replaceIgnoreCase(Text const& find, Text const& substitute) const throw()
00196 {
00197     Text thisLower = this->toLower();
00198     Text findLower = find.toLower();
00199     const int size = this->size();
00200     const int findLength = find.length();
00201     int startIndex = 0;
00202     int findIndex;
00203     
00204     Text result;
00205     
00206     while((findIndex = thisLower.indexOf(findLower, startIndex)) >= 0)
00207     {
00208         result <<= this->range(startIndex, findIndex);
00209         result <<= substitute;
00210         startIndex = findIndex + findLength;
00211     }
00212     
00213     result <<= this->range(startIndex, size);
00214     
00215     return result;
00216 }

00274 int TextArray::indexOf(Text const& item, const int startIndex) const throw()
00275 {
00276     ugen_assert(startIndex >= 0);
00277     
00278     const Text *array = this->getArray();
00279     
00280     if(array != 0)
00281     {
00282         const int length = this->length();
00283         for(int i = startIndex < 0 ? 0 : startIndex; i < length; i++)
00284         {
00285             if(array[i] == item)
00286                 return i;
00287         }
00288     }
00289     
00290     return -1;
00291 }

00313 {
